calculation_handling.description: Exception to the 10 metre separation from a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank on another lot: an ancillary building on a residential lot is exempt.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 10 metre value sits in the lead-in of (1), which has no unit of its own. The TRCA line is not held in our lot data.

calculation_handling.description: Exception to the 10 metre separation from a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank on another lot: conservation works, public utilities and transportation uses are exempt.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 10 metre value sits in the lead-in of (1), which has no unit of its own. The TRCA line is not held in our lot data.

calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing building closer to a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank than the required separation stays permitted, and may be altered or replaced on the same lot if it is no closer at any point along its main walls.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built wall positions and the TRCA line, neither held in our lot data.

5.10.40.80(1).explanation: On Toronto and Region Conservation Authority lands, a building or structure may be no closer than 10 metres to a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank on another lot. Ancillary buildings on residential lots and conservation works, public utilities and transportation uses are exempt.

5.10.40.80(2).explanation: A lawfully existing building already closer than the required separation to a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank may stay. It may be altered or replaced on the same lot if it is no closer to the line at any point along its main walls.
